ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, AB is the diameter of the semicircle O, and $\angle BAC=40^\circ$. What is the measure of $\angle D$ in degrees?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Let $AB$ be the diameter of the semicircle O,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle ACB = 90^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle BAC + \angle B = 90^\circ$,\\
Since $\angle BAC = 40^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle B = 90^\circ - \angle BAC = 90^\circ - 40^\circ = 50^\circ$,\\
Since $\angle B + \angle D = 180^\circ$,\\
$\therefore$ $\angle D = 180^\circ - 50^\circ = \boxed{130^\circ}$.
